trainer/30171.htm.text: Magister Gaius: Welcome, o seeker of truth, to the Ivory Tower! Magic is both a tool and a weapon, capable of great good or horrific evil. Even some of our most illustrious wizards have strayed into dark paths over the years. Only the Elves have remained immune to corruption. But let me say this. M…

trainer/30171-1.htm.text: Magister Gaius: My master's name was Metheus. He was an indomitable Human, unafraid of making mistakes in his quest for knowledge. His thousands of magical experiments have borne bountiful fruit, transforming how many of us now see magic. Perhaps his most useful research concerned the "magic boost.…

trainer/30171-noteach.htm.text: Magister Gaius: I don't think that you're somebody I can teach. Why don't you go upstairs? Gauen is younger that other Elves, but he might be an excellent teacher for you. On the other hand, there is also Kaiena. She may be a little difficult to deal with at times, but she is an accomplished magus.…

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30171-01.html.text: Magister Gaius: Gasp... Is it you, Kamael? I have nothing to say to you...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30171-02.html.text: Magister Gaius: Gasp... Is it you, Kamael? I have nothing to say to you...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30171-06.html.text: Magister Gaius: Well, one of the followers of that villain Beleth managed to obtain certain secrets about the Kamael. They were in a document that contained excerpts of medical research conducted by the Giants. Our lord discovered that this information was passed to the other followers of Beleth in…

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30171-09.html.text: Magister Gaius: The research document of the Giants disappeared during the attack by the Manashen Gargoyles near the Ivory Tower.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30171-10.html.text: Magister Gaius: What? You found the charm of the royal forefathers? The one containing the seal of the Ivory Tower? If we locate all the charms, we may still be able to discover who was responsible for the attack. Could there be a follow of Beleth at the Ivory Tower itself?

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30171-11.html.text: Magister Gaius: What? The charm of the royal forefathers belongs to Gauen!? What has he say about that? He must be made to answer -- go speak to him at once!

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30171-12.html.text: Magister Gaius: Gauen said such a thing?! I can scarcely credit it, but I trust Kaiena.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30171-13.html.text: Magister Gaius: So that is how the research document of the Giants fell into Beleth's clutches! All our efforts were in vain... Kaiena must have been distracted indeed by other matters not to have sent word of this to me. Gauen must pay for this betrayal!

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30171-03.html.text: Magister Gaius: How can you say that? How rude!

links.text: Show him the written request for attack.

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30171-04.html.text: Magister Gaius: Groan... And there is no other way? Then I suppose I must tell you everything... I only did it because I was asked to. Nor do I think it was a bad thing!

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30171-05.html.text: Magister Gaius: Groan... And there is no other way? Then I suppose I must tell you everything... I only did it because I was asked to. Nor do I think it was a bad thing!

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30171-07.html.text: Magister Gaius: Yes, well, I understand your point, but... Well, this is how the world works, after all. ...

links.text: Were you able to recover the Giants' research document?

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/30171-08.html.text: Magister Gaius: Well, yes and no. One of our operatives did recover the document near Death Pass, but... while en route to us, he was attacked by the Manashen Gargoyles near the Ivory Tower. links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
